dm_single:
سلام! مرسی که کامنت گذاشتی 😊

3 پرامپت آماده برای برنامه‌ریزی روز و هفته 👇
جاهای خالی رو پر کن:

1. برنامه‌ی امروز:
"My tasks with deadlines and time estimates: ___. I work ___ to ___, fixed meetings at ___, and I focus best in the ___. Time-block my day: hardest tasks in my best hours, add 25% extra time to each estimate, and a short break every 90 minutes."
2. برنامه‌ی هفته:
"Plan my week from this list: ___. Put each task on a day based on its deadline, leave one free block each day for surprises, and show it as a table."
3. وقتی به هم ریخت:
"It's ___ now and I didn't finish ___. Re-plan the rest of my day and tell me what to drop or move to tomorrow."

راهنمای پرامپت‌نویسی: platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/overview
